definition: f_A-f_B; fractions of resolved informative quartets matching the arrangement and independently frozen baseline splits
arrangement_labels: primary contrast uses frozen arrangement and baseline labels
mutation_rate_sensitivity: labels are dimensionless, but missingness and tree inference can vary with rate
MSRC_status: model-supported observable in the reduced conditional quartet analysis; empirical spatial result

definition: arrangement-informed opposite-minus-same SNAPP population-tree divergence-time contrast
input_and_units: SNAPP population-tree time summaries; SNAPP time units
normalization: robust median/MAD or model-specific scaling in Stage 12b
topology_dependence: none after conditioning on pair classes
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common rate scaling may cancel only if the time estimator is proportionally scaled; estimator-specific confounding remains
MSRC_status: simulation-supported/reduced-model comparison; not a realized coalescence-time law

definition: mean internal branch length among the local SNAPP population-tree representation
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common scaling is not removed by raw means; normalized variants are only sensitivity analyses

definition: q_T-q_S, alternative topology support minus species-history topology support
input_and_units: IQ-TREE ML local trees; dimensionless support fractions
normalization: pooled support fractions; unresolved handling follows source track
arrangement_labels: TTT/arrangement-specific design for A track; ALL_TIPS topology contrast itself is arrangement-independent
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common mutation factor does not enter support directly, but tree-estimation error can change support
MSRC_status: observed topology signal; no finite-M mouse theorem evaluation

definition: arrangement-informed mean patristic-distance contrast from the frozen Stage 4 track
input_and_units: IQ-TREE ML patristic distances; substitution units
normalization: raw difference; A_relative divides by a pooled distance scale
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common factor multiplies A_distance and cancels in A_relative; lineage-specific factors do not cancel

input_and_units: IQ-TREE ML patristic distances; substitution units
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common factor multiplies B; terminal-branch artifacts and lineage-specific rates remain
MSRC_status: arrangement-blind empirical/descriptive; Stage 6 found a taxon-specific discontinuity

mutation_rate_sensitivity: support is indirectly affected by rate and SNP-density effects through tree inference
MSRC_status: observed topology signal; no finite-M branch-length theorem

definition: balanced within-species opposite-haplotype mean distance minus same-haplotype mean distance
input_and_units: NJ local trees; patristic substitution-distance units
normalization: species-balanced class means; A_relative divides by mean pair distance
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common factor cancels in A_relative but not A_distance; lineage-specific and haplotype-specific rates remain

definition: q_H-q_S, focal opposite-haplotype topology support minus species-history support
mutation_rate_sensitivity: indirect sensitivity through estimated trees; no branch-length scale
MSRC_status: observed topology signal; no finite-M branch-length theorem

definition: balanced opposite-haplotype patristic mean minus balanced same-haplotype patristic mean
normalization: group-balanced means; A_relative divides by six-pair mean
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common factor multiplies A_distance and cancels in A_relative; lineage-specific rates remain
MSRC_status: empirical/descriptive; fire-ant topology/length separation is not an MSRC proof

definition: separate alternative quartet supports minus the species-history support for Columbea, N61, and N62 designs
arrangement_labels: no universal binary arrangement partition is available
mutation_rate_sensitivity: support indirectly depends on tree-estimation quality
MSRC_status: empirical/descriptive; no universal A(w) was defined

normalization: mean over complete mapped taxon pairs
mutation_rate_sensitivity: common factor scales it; lineage-specific and taxon-specific effects remain

definition: (x-med(x))/(1.4826 MAD), with source-specific fallback scale floors
input_and_units: window feature vectors; source units retained before scaling
mutation_rate_sensitivity: standardization removes a common affine scale for a feature within a track, not branch-specific rate variation
MSRC_status: detector preprocessing, not a biological observable
